Alistar.watch: Watch your positioning so Alistar W Headbutt cannot push you into Alistar Q Pulverize's knockup and Alistar E Trample's stun. Near your turret, do not give Alistar room to get behind you.
Alistar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Alistar's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Alistar.fight: Counterattack right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are used. Slow him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then trade with meep empowered basic attacks. Look for a stun when a wall or another enemy is behind him.
Alistar.combo: Once Alistar W Headbutt is down, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Move sideways until Alistar and a wall line up, then fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with meep empowered basic attacks.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is a mobility ability he uses to engage, so the moment it is down is your opening to go in with Bard E Magical Journey. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, use that time to close the gap or reposition.
Alistar.phase: Early on, Bard needs time to collect chimes, so watch for engages with Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize. Later, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Alistar.teamfight: Instead of standing in front to absorb Alistar's damage, pin him to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding when he engages and target the damage dealers behind him. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off instead of committing damage; if he has already activated it, Bard Q Cosmic Binding can interrupt another engage. When using Bard R Tempered Fate to put enemy damage dealers or late arrivals in stasis, aim so your own damage dealers are not caught too.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is an area slow used for poke, so dodge to the side of its cone and look for an opening right after it is used. Ashe P Frost Shot's slow refreshes with every basic attack, so do not stay in her basic attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, do not start a skirmish from outside your team's vision; if it comes toward you, change direction to dodge it.
Ashe.fight: Trade when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is inactive. Close the gap in one move with Bard E Magical Journey, land Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and follow with basic attacks if you have meeps stacked.
Ashe.combo: Approach with Bard E Magical Journey, then fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding from a position that lines Ashe up with a wall or another enemy behind her. If it stuns, follow with meep empowered basic attacks. If you first put Ashe in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for when it ends, but take care not to catch your own damage dealer in stasis.
Ashe.escape: Your opening to go in is when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is inactive. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is also down, the risk of being stunned is lower, so close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Enemies can use the portal too, so check whether anyone can follow before opening that route.
Ashe.phase: As Bard collects more chimes, his meep empowered basic attacks and movement speed grow stronger, making his roams faster.
Ashe.teamfight: Use Bard E Magical Journey with your allies to reach Ashe from an unexpected direction. Stun Ashe by connecting her to a wall or another enemy with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, or briefly take her out of the fight with Bard R Tempered Fate. Aim Bard R Tempered Fate so your own damage dealer is not caught in stasis, and do not stand in front trying to absorb damage.

Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you are hit by consecutive abilities, so dodge the first hit, especially Brand Q Sear and Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you are ablaze, watch for the stun from Brand Q Sear: move out of the projectile's path or hide behind a minion. Keep your distance from burning minions, as Brand E Conflagration can spread from them.
Brand.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Brand deals mostly magic damage and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Brand.fight: Right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Dodge Brand Q Sear, then lock him down with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with meep empowered basic attacks. To look for a stun, position yourself so Brand lines up with a wall or a second enemy behind him.
Brand.combo: Once Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, approach with Bard E Magical Journey and move until Brand lines up with a wall or another enemy behind him. Look for a stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then land meep empowered basic attacks. If you first put Brand in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding in advance for when it ends.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility ability, so the opening to go in with Bard E Magical Journey comes after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used. Brand Q Sear only stuns targets that are ablaze, so if you are ablaze, dodge its projectile before engaging.
Brand.phase: Early on, Bard needs time to collect chimes, so collect only those along safe routes and do not leave your lane partner alone for long. Later, keep your distance from allies so Brand cannot hit you together, and focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Brand.teamfight: Brand E Conflagration spreads around targets that are ablaze, and Brand R Pyroclasm bounces between enemies, so do not stand beside an ally who is ablaze. Pin Brand to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, or briefly take him out of the fight with Bard R Tempered Fate. Aim Bard R Tempered Fate so your own damage dealer is not caught in stasis too.

Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls the first target it hits, so keep minions in front of you and stay away from bushes without vision. If pulled, you may also be hit by the knockup from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field, so avoid engaging until Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses.
Blitzcrank.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Prioritize magic resistance against Blitzcrank's main damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field. Magic resistance will not block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Blitzcrank.fight: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, slow him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with meep empowered basic attacks. Target an enemy with a wall behind them or one overlapping a minion to get the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding as well.
Blitzcrank.combo: When Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Line up a wall or another enemy behind your target to stun them, then follow with meep empowered basic attacks. If you first put them in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for when it ends, but aim so your own damage dealer is not caught in stasis too.
Blitzcrank.escape: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your opening to go in. If Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field are also down, the risk of being locked down is lower, so approach with Bard E Magical Journey and look for Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Enemies can use the portal too, so check whether they can follow before opening it.
Blitzcrank.phase: Later, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Rather than standing in front to absorb damage, stay behind your allies and stop Blitzcrank's engage. If Blitzcrank gets close, pin him to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and use Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly take the enemy's main damage dealer or late arrivals out of the fight. At dragon or Baron, coordinate with your ally's Smite timing, then use Bard R Tempered Fate to put both the objective and enemies in stasis and delay the Smite contest.

Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter's Bite or an auto attack applies a stack of Braum P Concussive Blows, move out of range before the stun stacks are completed. Do not use Bard Q Cosmic Binding into the direction Braum E Unbreakable faces; wait for the shield to drop or for an angle from the side. When you see the cast animation for Braum R Glacial Fissure, move sideways out of its path and avoid the slowing area it leaves behind.
Braum.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Braum P Concussive Blows, Braum Q Winter's Bite, and Braum R Glacial Fissure deal mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Braum.fight: Block Braum Q Winter's Bite with minions, then trade briefly with a meep auto attack after the slow from Bard Q Cosmic Binding. When Braum E Unbreakable is up, do not use Bard Q Cosmic Binding from the front; fight when the shield drops or you can move around its side. Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used, close the distance with Bard E Magical Journey and look for a stun angle with Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Braum.combo: When Braum W Stand Behind Me has been used, approach with Bard E Magical Journey and position so the enemy lines up with a wall or a second enemy. Avoid the front of Braum E Unbreakable, then stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep auto attack. If you put Braum in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, set up a stun angle for Bard Q Cosmic Binding where he will emerge, and avoid catching your allied damage dealer in the stasis.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used is your window to close the distance with Bard E Magical Journey. Go in when Braum E Unbreakable is down or you can land Bard Q Cosmic Binding from outside the direction his shield faces. Enemies can also use Bard E Magical Journey, so check whether anyone can follow you through.
Braum.phase: In the late game, pick off the target Braum is protecting or an enemy arriving late instead of continuing to attack Braum.
Braum.teamfight: Find an angle for Bard Q Cosmic Binding from the side so your allies' attacks do not all hit the front of Braum E Unbreakable. Pin an engaging enemy to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and use Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly take the enemy's main damage dealer or late arrivals out of the fight. If you use Bard R Tempered Fate on Dragon or Baron, coordinate your ally's Smite timing beforehand.

Heimerdinger.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Heimerdinger deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.fight: Do not keep trading damage in front of Heimerdinger's turrets. Close the distance with Bard E Magical Journey from a flank or brush, then land Bard Q Cosmic Binding and a meep auto attack.
Heimerdinger.combo: Approach from the side with Bard E Magical Journey, then position so Heimerdinger lines up with a wall and fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding. If it passes through Heimerdinger and hits the wall or a second enemy to stun him, follow with a meep auto attack.
Heimerdinger.escape: Enemies can also use Bard E Magical Journey, so check whether anyone can follow you through when you go in.
Heimerdinger.phase: In the late game, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, do not group with your allies at one spot in a narrow passage or near an objective. Use a wall to stun an enemy with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and use Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly take the enemy's main damage dealer or late arrivals out of the fight. Aim Bard R Tempered Fate carefully so it does not also put your allied damage dealer in stasis.

Hwei.watch: If you are rooted or pulled by Hwei E Subject: Torment, you are likely to take follow-up damage. If the first ability hits, move immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on maximum health, so walk out of its telegraphed area.
Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Because Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, get magic resistance and movement speed instead of stacking only health.
Hwei.fight: Right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to poke or clear the wave is your chance to close the distance. Approach with Bard E Magical Journey, land Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and continue the trade with an auto attack if you have a meep ready. To stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, first position so a wall or another enemy is behind Hwei.
Hwei.combo: When Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used, approach with Bard E Magical Journey and fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding from a position where Hwei lines up with a wall or another enemy. Follow with an auto attack if you have a meep ready. If you first put him in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, set up an angle for Bard Q Cosmic Binding where he will emerge, but avoid catching your allied damage dealer as well.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used is your window to engage. Close the distance with Bard E Magical Journey and catch him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, its root or forced movement can stop your engage, so do not lead the way in.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Hwei.teamfight: If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, the first ally to engage may be rooted or pushed away, so watch for its use before moving in. Pin an engaging enemy to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and use Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly take Hwei out of the fight or stop an enemy arriving late. Bard R Tempered Fate also affects allies, so aim it where it will not interrupt your allied damage dealer's attacks.

Janna.watch: The knock-up from Janna Q Howling Gale is dangerous, so if you hear a tornado from brush or outside your vision, avoid its path. A target with Janna E Eye Of The Storm has a shield and a stronger counterattack, so do not focus your damage on them at that moment. Watch out for Janna R Monsoon pushing nearby enemies away when you engage.
Janna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads. Janna deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Janna.fight: Right after Janna uses Janna E Eye Of The Storm, target someone without the shield or wait for it to expire. When Bard has a meep auto attack ready, slow with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with the auto attack. If you line it up with a wall or a second enemy, you can also look for the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Janna.combo: Position so Janna lines up with a wall or a second enemy behind her, then look for a stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep auto attack. If you put Janna in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, set up an angle for Bard Q Cosmic Binding where she will emerge. Be careful not to catch your allied damage dealer in Bard R Tempered Fate as well.
Janna.escape: After Janna Q Howling Gale misses is your chance to close the distance. Approach with an ally through Bard E Magical Journey from an unexpected direction and set up a stun angle for Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Enemies can also use Bard E Magical Journey, so check whether anyone can follow you through.
Janna.phase: In the late game, establish vision and pick off Janna when she is isolated, or join teamfights.
Janna.teamfight: If Janna is behind her allied damage dealer, your engage will be pushed back, so get vision and look for a moment when Janna is alone. Use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to root an enemy against a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly take the enemy's main damage dealer or late-arriving players out of the fight. When using Bard R Tempered Fate in front of Dragon or Baron, coordinate in advance with your allies' Smite timing.

Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow. The zone from Karma R Mantra-enhanced Q explodes again after a short delay, so leave it immediately if hit. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away and break the tether before it roots you. Karma R Mantra’s cooldown shrinks as Karma’s abilities hit you, so avoid her poke from behind minions or outside her range.
Karma.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but if Karma W Focused Resolve connects, prioritize moving away to avoid the root.
Karma.fight: For trades, follow the slow from Bard Q Cosmic Binding with a meep-empowered basic attack. Once Karma E Inspire’s shield is down, use a wall or another enemy to set up a stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding. If Karma W Focused Resolve is down, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and start a fight.
Karma.combo: When Karma W Focused Resolve is down, approach with Bard E Magical Journey, land Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. Bard Q Cosmic Binding only stuns if there is a wall or another enemy behind Karma, so move sideways to line up the shot first. If Bard R Tempered Fate puts Karma in stasis, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for where she will emerge.
Karma.escape: The window to enter with Bard E Magical Journey is after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. If the shield from Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma E Inspire is active, wait for it to end before going in.
Karma.phase: In the late game, Bard focuses on picks and joining teamfights.
Karma.teamfight: While Karma W Focused Resolve is available, an ally who engages can be caught. Keep your distance and draw out that ability before fighting. If Karma R Mantra-enhanced Karma E Inspire shields nearby allies, attack after the shields expire. Use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin an engaging enemy to a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly take a main damage dealer or a late arrival out of the fight.

Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade passes through targets in a straight line and takes her to the last champion hit, so do not stand in line with your allied marksman. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so watch whether she is close enough to reach you rather than whether she has used it. When Leona W Eclipse activates, leave its area before it explodes. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center.
Leona.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to withstand the early lane. Choose Mercury's Treads and build magic resistance first against Leona’s magic damage.
Leona.fight: Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down is your chance to close the gap and counterattack. Approach with Bard E Magical Journey, then land Bard Q Cosmic Binding at an angle where it will hit a wall or a second enemy. For regular trades, follow the slow from Bard Q Cosmic Binding with a meep-empowered basic attack.
Leona.combo: When Leona E Zenith Blade is down, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Move sideways until Leona and a wall line up, then look for a stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. If Bard R Tempered Fate puts Leona in stasis, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for where she will emerge, but aim carefully so you do not put your allied damage dealer in stasis too.
Leona.escape: Go in right after Leona E Zenith Blade, her mobility tool, is down. Approach with Bard E Magical Journey and follow with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, but check whether an enemy can follow you through the portal, since enemies can use it too.
Leona.phase: As chimes accumulate, Bard’s meep-empowered basic attacks and movement speed grow stronger, making his roams faster.
Leona.teamfight: Instead of taking damage on the front line, use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin an engaging Leona to a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to cut off a main damage dealer or a late arrival. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, retreat immediately: it signals incoming follow-up damage. When using Bard R Tempered Fate near dragon or Baron to put both the objective and enemies in stasis, coordinate your ally’s Smite timing in advance.

Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences you and prevents you from attacking, so do not enter with Bard E Magical Journey while it is available. Lulu R Wild Growth can save its target and knock up nearby enemies, so do not commit to a kill on a target while she still has it.
Lulu.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to withstand the early lane, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lulu’s damage is mostly magic and Bard’s magic resistance is fairly low, so build magic resistance first.
Lulu.fight: After Lulu W Whimsy is down, slow her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and poke with basic attacks when you have meeps. If Lulu E Help, Pix! is used to shield an allied carry, it is an opportunity to approach Lulu herself with Bard E Magical Journey.
Lulu.combo: When Lulu W Whimsy is down, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding. To look for a stun, first position yourself so Lulu lines up with a wall or a second enemy behind her, then follow Bard Q Cosmic Binding with a meep-empowered basic attack.
Lulu.escape: Lulu has no dash to get herself out, so go in during the window after Lulu W Whimsy is down. If it is still available, wait: she can stop you even if you enter with Bard E Magical Journey.
Lulu.phase: Late game, focus on picking off enemies and influencing teamfights.
Lulu.teamfight: Use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin an engaging enemy to a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly cut off a main damage dealer or a late arrival. A target can survive if Lulu R Wild Growth is available, so target Lulu herself or someone else. Aim Bard R Tempered Fate carefully so it does not put your allied damage dealer in stasis too.

Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding can lead into her follow-up abilities if it hits, so do not stand in line with an ally; bait it out and dodge it. Walk out of Lux E Lucent Singularity’s area, and dodge sideways when the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears. If an ability applies Lux P Illumination’s mark to you, move away to avoid her empowered basic attack.
Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux’s main damage is magic and Bard’s magic resistance is fairly low, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.fight: A missed Lux Q Light Binding is your chance to fight. Position yourself so Lux lines up with a wall or a second enemy to look for a stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and trade with a basic attack if you have meeps. Lux’s magic resistance is fairly low, so Bard’s magic damage is effective against her too.
Lux.combo: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding. To look for a stun, line it up with a wall or a second enemy behind Lux. If Bard R Tempered Fate puts Lux in stasis, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for where she will emerge, but cast Bard R Tempered Fate so it does not catch your allied damage dealer too.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility ability, so bait and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then enter immediately with Bard E Magical Journey. Enemies can use the portal too, so be careful when opening one along an escape route Lux could follow.
Lux.phase: Late game, pick off Lux from the side or influence teamfights.
Lux.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and approach from different directions so Lux E Lucent Singularity cannot stop you all at once. Rather than taking damage on the front line, use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin an enemy to a wall and Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly cut off a main damage dealer or a late arrival. When using Bard R Tempered Fate near dragon or Baron, account for its effect on the objective and coordinate your ally’s Smite timing in advance.

Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks can follow, so move with minions between you and her. When low on health, do not retreat through Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles tethers you, use Bard E Magical Journey to leave its range before the stun.
Morgana.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Morgana deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Morgana.fight: Dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and fight when Morgana E Black Shield is down. Slow her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then trade with a meep-empowered basic attack. Look for a stun when a wall or another enemy is behind her.
Morgana.combo: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Move sideways to line her up with a wall, then stun her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. If you catch her first with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding where she will be when it ends.
Morgana.escape: An opening to engage comes when Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so approach with Bard E Magical Journey and look for Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Morgana.phase: Late game, focus on picks and influencing teamfights.
Morgana.teamfight: Instead of soaking damage up front, use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin an engaging enemy to a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to catch the enemy’s main damage dealer or late arrivals. Don’t use crowd control on a target with Morgana E Black Shield active. Bard R Tempered Fate also affects allies, so aim it to avoid stasis on your damage dealers.

Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick can knock Bard back and slow him, stopping an engage. Close the gap after Milio uses it. If Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and extends the enemy marksman's range, delay a front-line fight.
Milio.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle for durability and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Milio deals magic damage, so magic resistance is the first resistance Bard should build. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life becomes a problem, get a way to reduce healing.
Milio.fight: In lane, slow Milio with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then trade with a meep-empowered basic attack. When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and look for a Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun using a wall or a second enemy.
Milio.combo: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, approach with Bard E Magical Journey. Line Milio up with a wall behind him or a second enemy, stun him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. If you catch Milio with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding in advance where he will be when it ends.
Milio.escape: The moment after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick, his escape tool, is used is your chance to engage. Approach with Bard E Magical Journey, but check whether an enemy can follow through it, since opponents can use the portal too.
Milio.phase: Milio compositions grow stronger over time, so late game, focus on Bard's picks and disrupting teamfights.
Milio.teamfight: Milio has low defensive stats and no mobility, so if Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, focus him with your allies. Instead of soaking damage up front, use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin an engaging enemy to a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to catch the enemy’s main damage dealer or late arrivals. Bard R Tempered Fate also affects allies, so aim it to avoid stasis on your damage dealers.

Maokai.watch: Do not enter brush where Maokai E Sapling Toss has planted a sapling. When Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, keep your distance near brush. He cannot be targeted during the dash, so respond after he lands. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from afar, move perpendicular to its path and avoid narrow passages with no room to dodge.
Maokai.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Maokai's main damage, then choose further defenses based on the enemy damage dealer who attacks while Maokai holds you in place.
Maokai.fight: Right after Maokai W Twisted Advance has been used is your chance to step forward and trade. Slow him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then hit him with a meep-empowered basic attack. Look for a stun if you can line the shot up through him into a wall or another enemy.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance ends and he lands, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Move sideways to line him up with a wall or another enemy behind him, then hit Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. If you catch him first with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding where he will be when it ends, and aim Bard R Tempered Fate to avoid catching your damage dealer too.
Maokai.escape: Engage right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is used. If you have also dodged the root from Maokai R Nature's Grasp, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and catch him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Maokai.phase: Late game, Bard should focus on picks and influencing teamfights.
Maokai.teamfight: Pin an enemy who engages with Maokai W Twisted Advance to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and use Bard R Tempered Fate to temporarily remove a key enemy damage dealer or a late arrival from the fight. Fight in open terrain where you can dodge sideways, rather than in a narrow passage where Maokai R Nature's Grasp is coming. Before using Bard R Tempered Fate on an objective near dragon or Baron, coordinate its timing with your ally's Smite.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns, but lands slowly, so walk sideways when you see its warning. Nami R Tidal Wave also travels slowly; move sideways to dodge it and save Bard E Magical Journey for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow. Do not fight an enemy head-on while they have Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing. Reengage after it expires.
Nami.build: Early, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nami deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Nami.fight: Nami has low health and no mobility ability, so establish vision and target her. If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, slow her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with a meep-empowered basic attack. To look for a stun, position so a wall or another enemy is behind Nami.
Nami.combo: Move sideways until a wall or another enemy is behind Nami, then stun her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. If you catch Nami with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding in advance where she will be when it ends. Aim Bard R Tempered Fate to avoid catching your damage dealer too.
Nami.escape: The moment after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to engage. Do not immediately close in on an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; wait for it to expire. After dodging Nami's crowd control, use Bard E Magical Journey to close the gap on Nami, who has no mobility ability, and hit her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Nami.phase: Late game, Bard should focus on picks and influencing teamfights.
Nami.teamfight: Instead of soaking damage up front, use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin an engaging enemy to a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to catch the enemy’s main damage dealer or late arrivals. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, dodge sideways and prepare for the Aqua Prison that follows. Before using Bard R Tempered Fate to put both an objective and enemies in stasis near Dragon or Baron, coordinate your team’s Smite timing in advance.

Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engages and kill attempts, so keep minions between you and him to avoid it. If his first basic attack with Nautilus P Staggering Blow hits you up close, the root can lead into his other abilities, so stay out of basic attack range. When Nautilus R Depth Charge targets you, avoid standing in line with allies so it does not knock them up along its path.
Nautilus.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nautilus deals mainly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Nautilus.fight: Trade immediately after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Slow him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, follow with a meep-empowered basic attack, and stay out of Nautilus P Staggering Blow basic attack range. Near a wall, position so Bard Q Cosmic Binding hits him and the wall to stun him.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Move sideways to line up a wall or another enemy behind Nautilus, then stun him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. If you first put him in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding where the stasis will end, and aim Bard R Tempered Fate so it does not catch your allied damage dealer.
Nautilus.escape: Immediately after Nautilus Q Dredge Line is used, you have a window to engage or create distance with Bard E Magical Journey. Nautilus can use the portal too, so check whether he can follow before opening one to escape.
Nautilus.phase: Early on, Bard is ordinary before he has collected chimes, so watch for Nautilus Q Dredge Line engages first. Later, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Nautilus.teamfight: Instead of taking damage up front, bind the diving Nautilus against a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and separate him from your allies. Avoid standing on top of one another so Nautilus R Depth Charge doesn't knock up allies along its path. Use Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly remove the enemy's main damage dealer or late-arriving members from the fight, without stasis-locking your allied damage dealers too.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting a target in front, so do not stand on top of an ally. If an enemy disguised with Neeko P Inherent Glamour comes close, Neeko R Pop Blossom's windup may be hidden, so spread out early. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; track the real Neeko.
Neeko.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Neeko's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads, and prioritize tenacity if Neeko R Pop Blossom follows a root from Neeko E Tangle-Barbs.
Neeko.fight: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, slow her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with a meep-empowered basic attack. If a wall or another enemy is behind her, move sideways to line up a stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding before firing.
Neeko.combo: While Neeko R Pop Blossom is down, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Position so she lines up with a wall or a second enemy, stun her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. If you first put Neeko in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up a Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun where the stasis will end.
Neeko.escape: Especially when Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is also down, approach with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Neeko can use the portal too, so check whether she can follow.
Neeko.phase: Later, focus on picks and joining teamfights instead of taking damage at the front.
Neeko.teamfight: If an enemy disguised with Neeko P Inherent Glamour gets close, anticipate Neeko R Pop Blossom and spread out from your allies. Pin an engaging Neeko to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, or separate her from your allies with Bard R Tempered Fate. Bard R Tempered Fate also affects allies, so aim it to avoid catching your allied damage dealer.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so do not let him get close enough to use it. When Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke, keep minions between you and him. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon deals mainly physical damage, so build armor first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health, and Pantheon R Grand Starfall has penetration, so be careful about stacking large amounts of health or armor alone.
Pantheon.fight: Stay outside Pantheon W Shield Vault range, slow him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then trade with a meep-empowered basic attack. During Pantheon E Aegis Assault, do not attack him from the front; wait for it to end or move to his side.
Pantheon.combo: Position so a wall or another enemy is behind Pantheon, stun him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then follow with a meep-empowered basic attack. If you put Pantheon in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding where the stasis will end.
Pantheon.escape: You have an opening to engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is used and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. Close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding, but account for Pantheon being able to use the portal too.
Pantheon.phase: Later, focus on picks and joining teamfights against Pantheon as his impact falls off.
Pantheon.teamfight: When Pantheon engages, pin him to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding or put him in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate to separate him from your allies. Bard R Tempered Fate also puts allies in stasis, so adjust your aim to avoid catching your allied damage dealer.

Pyke.watch: Watch out for the pull from Pyke Q Bone Skewer and the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If Pyke dashes with Pyke E Phantom Undertow, dodge sideways out of the line between where he started and where he lands. A shark shadow beneath your feet means Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is nearby, so retreat toward allies or your turret.
Pyke.build: Pyke deals mainly physical damage, so consider health items first. If building resistance, choose armor over magic resistance. Since Pyke builds physical penetration early, secure enough health to stay above the Pyke R Death From Below execute threshold instead of adding only a small amount of armor.
Pyke.fight: In lane, slow Pyke with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then trade with a meep-empowered basic attack. After dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow sideways, exploit the window when the movement ability he uses to engage and escape is down. If Pyke R Death From Below is also still on cooldown, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Pyke.combo: Position so a wall or another enemy is behind Pyke, then fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stun him. If you put Pyke in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up the same Bard Q Cosmic Binding angle where the stasis will end. Aim Bard R Tempered Fate carefully so it does not catch your allied damage dealer.
Pyke.escape: Even if you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow, do not immediately go deep while Pyke R Death From Below is available. Use the window before Pyke R Death From Below is available again to approach with Bard E Magical Journey and stop his escape with Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Pyke.phase: Early on, Bard needs time to collect chimes, so watch for Pyke's engages and collect only chimes along safe routes. Later, move with low-health allies and focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Pyke.teamfight: Pin an engaging Pyke to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Use Bard R Tempered Fate to interrupt his engage or prevent a guaranteed finishing blow against an ally. Keep your distance from low-health allies so Pyke R Death From Below does not hit you alongside them. Injured allies should spread out too, so Pyke cannot chain executions.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance has a visible landing point, so move sideways as soon as he starts to avoid the knock-up. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, don’t stand in a line; put terrain between you, or catch him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding before he reaches you. Avoid trading while Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield is active.
Rakan.build: Rakan deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Rakan.fight: Just after Rakan’s P Fey Feathers shield breaks, slow him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with a Meeps-empowered basic attack. After dodging or drawing out Rakan W Grand Entrance, look for a chance to close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. If Rakan is separated from his allies, he can’t escape with Rakan E Battle Dance, so look for that moment.
Rakan.combo: After dodging Rakan W Grand Entrance’s landing to the side, aim Bard Q Cosmic Binding so it passes through a wall or another enemy behind him, and try to stun him. If there’s no angle, move sideways until you, Rakan, and a wall are in a straight line. If you stasis Rakan with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding at the spot where he will be released, but cast it so your allied damage dealers aren’t stasis-locked too.
Rakan.escape: Right after you force Rakan W Grand Entrance, you have a window to enter with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding. If Rakan is separated from his allies, he also has no target for Rakan E Battle Dance, giving you a chance to catch him. Enemies can use the portal too, so check whether anyone can follow you.
Rakan.phase: In the late game, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Rakan.teamfight: When Rakan engages with Rakan W Grand Entrance, look for an angle to pin him to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding just after he lands. Against Rakan R The Quickness, don’t stand in a line; put terrain between you or stop him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding before he reaches you. Use Bard R Tempered Fate to take the enemy’s main damage dealer out of the fight briefly or separate an engaging enemy from your allies.

Rell.watch: When Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and an ally, she may engage soon, so stop trading and move outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range. Rell Q Shattering Strike comes in a straight line, so dodge sideways. Keep your distance from allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can’t pull several of you in together.
Rell.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Rell deals mostly magic damage, so building magic resistance first is effective on Bard.
Rell.fight: From outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range, slow her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and poke with an empowered basic attack. Rell has low magic resistance early and no lane sustain, so use a wall or minion to set up a Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun and chip away at her health.
Rell.combo: Position so a wall or another enemy is behind Rell, then hit her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stun her and follow up with an empowered basic attack. If you stasis Rell with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding at the spot where she will be released, but cast it so your allied damage dealers aren’t stasis-locked too.
Rell.escape: Engage after both Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and Rell E Full Tilt have been used, especially before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up. Close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and block Rell’s escape with Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Rell.phase: In the late game, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Rell.teamfight: Before a teamfight, spread out from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can’t pull several of you together. Pin an engaging Rell to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and use Bard R Tempered Fate to stasis Rell or enemies arriving late, separating them from your allies.

Renata.watch: If Renata Glasc Q Handshake hits you, she can root and throw you, stunning your ally too, so avoid the initial hit from behind a minion or your frontline. When Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies so you aren’t hit together. Right after you take down an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, back off so they don’t get a chance to participate in a takedown.
Renata.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Renata Glasc deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Later, consider a way to remove crowd control to counter Renata Glasc Q Handshake and Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover.
Renata.fight: When your Meeps are ready, slow Renata Glasc with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with a Meeps-empowered basic attack. Renata Glasc has no innate mobility, so when you get a chance to close the gap, approach with your allies using Bard E Magical Journey and target Renata Glasc herself. If you want to follow up Bard Q Cosmic Binding with a stun, first position yourself so Renata Glasc lines up with the wall behind her or a second enemy.
Renata.combo: Use Bard E Magical Journey with your allies to approach from an unexpected direction, then position so a wall or a second enemy is behind Renata Glasc. Try to stun her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow up with an empowered basic attack. If you stasis Renata Glasc first with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding at the spot where she will be released, but cast it so your allied damage dealers aren’t stasis-locked too.
Renata.escape: Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so when crowd control such as Renata Glasc Q Handshake has been used, you have a chance to close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. In a teamfight while Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is ready, keep your distance from allies as you enter. Enemies can use Bard E Magical Journey too, so check whether anyone can follow before you go in.
Renata.phase: In the late game, focus on picks and joining teamfights instead of taking damage on the frontline.
Renata.teamfight: Spread out as you enter so several allies aren’t hit by Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover together. Pin an engaging enemy to a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, or use Bard R Tempered Fate to take the enemy’s main damage dealer and late arrivals out of the fight briefly. Bard R Tempered Fate also affects allies, so watch your allied damage dealers’ positions. When using it on an objective, coordinate your allied Smite timing in advance.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions in a straight line, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. If Senna W Last Embrace marks you, move away from allies before the root spreads. If Senna hits you once, back away to avoid taking a second attack and prevent her from collecting mist.
Senna.build: Build armor first to deal with Senna’s main damage. Senna P Absolution deals damage based on current health, so don’t stack health alone; build armor too. Reducing attack speed can also help lower the damage from Senna’s basic attacks.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps forward to collect a soul, poke her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and an empowered basic attack. To set up a Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun, position so a wall or another enemy is behind Senna. After Senna W Last Embrace is used, look for a chance to close the gap with your allies using Bard E Magical Journey.
Senna.combo: Move into a position where a wall or another enemy is in a straight line behind Senna, then hit her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stun her and follow up with an empowered basic attack. If there’s no such angle, Bard Q Cosmic Binding will only slow her, so move sideways first to create one. If you stasis Senna with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding at the spot where she will be released, but make sure you don’t stasis-lock your allied damage dealers too.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace misses or is used, you have a chance to close the gap. Don’t force a chase while Senna E Curse of the Black Mist boosts her movement speed; when engaging, use Bard E Magical Journey with your allies. Enemies can use the portal too, so check whether they can follow.
Senna.phase: In the late game, watch out as Senna P Absolution increases her range and attack damage, and focus on picks and joining teamfights as Bard.
Senna.teamfight: When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back away to a place with vision or throw Bard Q Cosmic Binding into the mist to stop her engage. Use Bard R Tempered Fate to take Senna out of the fight briefly or catch enemies arriving late. Pin enemies against a wall with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and protect your allies in fights instead of absorbing damage on the frontline.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets, so if you are slowed, move out of the line directly in front of her. When your health is low, watch for Seraphine Q High Note, which deals damage based on your missing health. In teamfights, spread out sideways from allies so Seraphine R Encore's charm does not reach the backline.
Seraphine.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Seraphine.fight: Trade when Seraphine is alone, away from her marksman. Slow her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then land a basic attack with meeps stacked. If you can hit a wall or a second enemy, look for the stun too. Right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is used, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey.
Seraphine.combo: Once Seraphine E Beat Drop is used, approach with Bard E Magical Journey. Move sideways to line Seraphine up with a wall behind her or a second enemy, then stun her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and land a meep basic attack. If you first put Seraphine in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding where she will emerge, and throw Bard R Tempered Fate so it does not catch your marksman too.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no dash, so right after she misses Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Seraphine.phase: Later on, focus on picks and influencing teamfights.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out sideways from allies to keep Seraphine R Encore from chaining through several people. Use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stun enemies near walls, and Bard R Tempered Fate to temporarily take a key enemy damage dealer or a late arrival out of the fight. Before using Bard R Tempered Fate near dragon or Baron, coordinate its timing with your ally's Smite.

Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns targets it hits in a line, so do not line up with allies when Sona steps forward. If Sona appears to have Sona P Power Chord ready and moves into basic attack range, back away to avoid the empowered attack's damage or slow.
Sona.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sona deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Sona.fight: Trade when Sona steps forward to apply her aura. Slow her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then land a basic attack with meeps stacked. If you can use a wall or minion, look for the stun too.
Sona.combo: When a wall is behind Sona or she lines up with a minion, stun her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then land a meep basic attack. If you lack the angle, move sideways to line Sona up with a wall. If you put Sona in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding where she will emerge, and throw Bard R Tempered Fate so it does not catch your marksman too.
Sona.escape: After Sona R Crescendo is used, you can engage without risking its stun. Approach with Bard E Magical Journey before she creates distance with Sona E Song of Celerity, and line up a stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding to keep her from escaping.
Sona.phase: Pressure Sona early, before she builds up Sona P Power Chord's scaling stacks. She grows stronger over time, so later on, focus on picks and disrupting teamfights instead of prolonged fights.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out sideways from allies so Sona R Crescendo cannot hit several of you. Putting Sona in stasis away from her team with Bard R Tempered Fate makes it harder for her to share Sona W Aria of Perseverance's healing and shield, and Sona E Song of Celerity's movement speed, with nearby allies. Use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stun an engaging enemy against a wall or Bard R Tempered Fate to cut off reinforcements, and have your team buy at least one anti-heal item.

Soraka.watch: Soraka Q Starcall slows you and heals Soraka, so dodge it while trading. Entering Soraka E Equinox's area silences you and can lead to a root, so use Bard E Magical Journey before stepping into it. Soraka R Wish heals allies regardless of distance, so account for it even when going for a kill.
Soraka.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Soraka deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If fights last long enough for repeated healing, consider anti-heal after resistance.
Soraka.fight: As soon as Soraka E Equinox is used, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Slow her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with a basic attack with meeps stacked. To look for a stun, position so a wall or another enemy is behind Soraka.
Soraka.combo: Once Soraka E Equinox is used, approach with Bard E Magical Journey. Move sideways to line Soraka up with a wall, then stun her with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and land a meep basic attack. If you first put Soraka in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding where she will emerge, and throw Bard R Tempered Fate so it does not catch your marksman too.
Soraka.escape: Soraka has no dash, so right after Soraka E Equinox is used is your chance to engage. Use Bard E Magical Journey to approach before stepping into its area, then use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stop her escape.
Soraka.phase: Bard needs time to collect chimes early, so do not leave lane recklessly. Later on, focus on picks and influencing teamfights.
Soraka.teamfight: Look for a chance to pick off Soraka herself rather than keep hitting enemies she heals. Put Soraka in stasis or cut off a late-arriving enemy with Bard R Tempered Fate, then prepare Bard Q Cosmic Binding where they will emerge. Aim Bard R Tempered Fate so it does not catch your marksman too.

Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and then returns, so even after dodging the first pass, stay out of its path until it has completely disappeared. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with more bolts up close, so keep your distance. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move out of range to stop his healing, then fight again after it ends.
Swain.build: Swain deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If fights run long, get anti-heal after resistance to counter healing from Swain P Ravenous Flock and Swain R Demonic Ascension.
Swain.fight: Right after Swain E Nevermove is used, engage with your allies using Bard E Magical Journey. Slow or stun him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then trade with a basic attack with meeps stacked. Otherwise, keep your distance so multiple bolts from Swain Q Death's Hand do not hit you.
Swain.combo: When a wall is behind Swain or he lines up with another enemy, stun him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then land a meep basic attack. If you lack the angle, move sideways to line him up with a wall before firing. If you put Swain in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding where he will emerge, taking care not to catch your marksman too.
Swain.escape: Dodge both the outgoing and returning passes of Swain E Nevermove before engaging. Right after it is used, Swain has no dash to escape, so close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Swain.phase: Later on, Swain's stacked health makes him harder to kill with the same setup. Get anti-heal and focus on picks and influencing teamfights.
Swain.teamfight: When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, do not fight near him long enough to let him heal. Move out of range, then reengage after it ends. Use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stun an engaging enemy against a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to temporarily take a key enemy damage dealer or a late arrival out of the fight. You can also use Bard R Tempered Fate to protect an ally just as an enemy finishing ability is about to hit them.

Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle has a delay, so move sideways when you see it coming. The stun also comes from the ally linked by Taric W Bastion, so keep your distance from both Taric and the linked champion. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to hold enemies in place until it ends.
Taric.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Taric deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first on Bard.
Taric.fight: Sidestep Taric E Dazzle to make him miss, then poke with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and a meep attack. Taric's Bravado passive brings his abilities back faster when he lands basic attacks, so fight at a distance. To set up a stun, position so a wall or another enemy is behind Taric.
Taric.combo: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, slow him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep attack. To aim for a stun, first move sideways until Taric and a wall line up. If you put Taric in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for when it ends, and take care not to catch your damage dealer in Bard R Tempered Fate.
Taric.escape: Once Taric E Dazzle is down, Bard has an opening to go in. If you can dodge the stun and catch Taric, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Enemies can use the portal too, so check whether anyone can follow before entering.
Taric.phase: Late game, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Taric.teamfight: When you see Taric begin casting Taric R Cosmic Radiance, pull your allies back or disrupt the enemy damage dealer. Stop attacking while the damage immunity is active. Hold enemies in place with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then attack again when the immunity ends. Instead of taking damage at the front, use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stop enemies who engage, and Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly isolate a key enemy damage dealer or someone arriving late.

Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence has a long cast animation, but a hit can lead to a stun and an engage. Move sideways as he raises his hook, and change direction again when stepping up for a last hit. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay does not pull you toward them.
Thresh.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle for defense and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Thresh deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Thresh.fight: When Thresh steps forward to collect a soul, slow him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with a meep attack. Close the gap after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, but watch your timing more carefully if Thresh W Dark Passage is still available.
Thresh.combo: Position so a wall or another enemy is behind Thresh, then fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with a meep attack. If you put Thresh in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up a Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun for when it ends. Watch your cast direction so Bard R Tempered Fate does not also catch your damage dealer.
Thresh.escape: Right after sidestepping Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the gap. If Thresh W Dark Passage is also down and has not come back, approach with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Enemies can use the portal too, so open it carefully where it could give them a path to chase.
Thresh.phase: Late game, stop Thresh's engages and focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Thresh.teamfight: When Thresh goes in, use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin him against a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly isolate a key enemy damage dealer or someone arriving late. If an ally is trapped in Thresh R The Box, immediately choose which wall to break through. Before using Bard R Tempered Fate around Dragon or Baron, coordinate its timing with your ally's Smite.

Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits, so dodging sideways alone is not enough. Move toward Vel'Koz or back into an area the beam has already passed. If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption knocks you up and more abilities hit, Vel'Koz's Organic Deconstruction passive deals true damage. Back off and let the stacks expire.
Velkoz.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle for defense and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Vel'Koz's main ability damage, but resistance cannot stop the true damage from Vel'Koz's Organic Deconstruction passive, so prioritize avoiding consecutive hits.
Velkoz.fight: In lane, slow Vel'Koz with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then trade with a meep attack. If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Line up a wall or another enemy behind Vel'Koz to aim for a Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun.
Velkoz.combo: After dodging Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, approach with Bard E Magical Journey. Fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding when Vel'Koz has a wall behind him or lines up with a minion, aiming for a stun, then follow with a meep attack. If you first put Vel'Koz in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for when it ends.
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so your opening to go in comes right after you avoid Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Approach with Bard E Magical Journey, but check whether an enemy can follow, since they can use the portal too.
Velkoz.phase: Late game, clear vision and look for a pick on Vel'Koz or join teamfights.
Velkoz.teamfight: When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, prioritize finding an angle to interrupt its channel with a Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun. Use Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly take Vel'Koz out of the fight or stop an enemy arriving late, and adjust your aim so your damage dealer is not caught too.

Xerath.watch: A stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb makes it easy for him to land follow-up attacks, so take particular care to dodge it. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions; when you see him charging it, change direction and move sideways. Watch for the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction too, and start dodging as soon as you see Xerath begin casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath deals mostly magic damage, and Bard has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.fight: In lane, start trades by slowing Xerath with Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then landing a meep attack. When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, you have an opening to close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. To aim for a Bard Q Cosmic Binding stun, first position so Xerath lines up with a wall or a second enemy behind him.
Xerath.combo: When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, approach with Bard E Magical Journey, land Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and follow with a meep attack. To aim for a stun, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding so it passes through Xerath and hits a wall or a second enemy. If you first put Xerath in stasis with Bard R Tempered Fate, set up that angle for when it ends, but cast it so your damage dealer is not caught too.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your opening to go in. Close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey and catch him with Bard Q Cosmic Binding. Enemies can use the portal too, so check whether anyone can follow before opening it.
Xerath.phase: Late game, focus on picks and joining teamfights.
Xerath.teamfight: Instead of taking damage at the front, use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to pin enemies against walls, and Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly take a key damage dealer like Xerath out of the fight. Xerath cannot move during Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, so look for a chance to engage on his position. Before using Bard R Tempered Fate around Dragon or Baron, coordinate its timing with your ally's Smite.

Zilean.watch: Two hits from Zilean Q Time Bomb on the same target cause a stun. If the first bomb attaches to you, move away from your allies and out of its blast radius. Be careful not to take the second bomb while slowed by Zilean E Time Warp.
Zilean.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to withstand the early lane and choose Mercury's Treads. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance, though tenacity has a more immediate impact when his bomb stun and slow keep you locked down.
Zilean.fight: When you have meeps stacked, slow Zilean with Bard Q Cosmic Binding and trade with meep attacks. To stun him, look for an angle with a wall or another enemy behind him.
Zilean.combo: Approach with your allies from an unexpected direction through Bard E Magical Journey, then fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding at an angle that reaches a wall or another enemy behind Zilean. If you catch Zilean with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for when it ends, and throw Bard R Tempered Fate so it does not catch your damage dealer too.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no dash, so you have chances to close the gap. If you go in alone after being slowed by Zilean E Time Warp, his bomb combo can lock you down. After he uses Zilean E Time Warp, engage together from multiple directions. When opening Bard E Magical Journey, check whether enemies can follow you through it.
Zilean.teamfight: Instead of using all your abilities on an enemy affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, wait for its duration to end or target them just after they revive. If that enemy is hard to kill, switch targets to Zilean. Use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stun an engaging enemy against a wall, or Bard R Tempered Fate to take the enemy's main damage dealer out of the fight briefly.

Zyra.watch: At the edge of its range, sidestep the straight-line root from Zyra E Grasping Roots. When the marker for Zyra R Stranglethorns appears, walk out of its area; use Bard E Magical Journey to escape if needed. Avoid fighting where her plants are clustered.
Zyra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads. Zyra's damage is mostly magic, and Bard's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Zyra.fight: After sidestepping Zyra E Grasping Roots, close the gap with Bard E Magical Journey. Look for a stun with Bard Q Cosmic Binding when Zyra has a wall behind her or lines up with a minion, then follow with attacks if you have meeps ready. Retreat from areas with many plants and fight again where there are none.
Zyra.combo: When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, approach with Bard E Magical Journey. Move to the side to line Zyra up with a wall or second enemy behind her, then fire Bard Q Cosmic Binding and follow with meep attacks. If you catch Zyra with Bard R Tempered Fate, line up Bard Q Cosmic Binding for when it ends, and throw Bard R Tempered Fate so it does not catch your damage dealer too.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so the moment after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to engage. Approach with Bard E Magical Journey and land Bard Q Cosmic Binding. If Zyra R Stranglethorns is cast, stop your engage and leave its area.
Zyra.phase: Later, focus on picks and influencing teamfights, and avoid areas where Zyra has built up plants.
Zyra.teamfight: Do not take a fight where Zyra has been set up for a while. Move to another objective and fight in fresh terrain. Use Bard Q Cosmic Binding to stun an engaging enemy against a wall, and Bard R Tempered Fate to briefly keep the enemy's main damage dealer or a late arrival out of the fight. When using Bard R Tempered Fate near dragon or Baron, coordinate its timing with your ally's Smite in advance.
